park_factor.description: Slightly hitter-friendly park in Busan. Moderate offensive boost.

stats.notes: Inconsistent offense. Pitching staff has struggled with command (elevated BB/9). Bullpen is shaky. Average home team.
Solid all-around club. Above-average offense with decent power. Starting pitching has been consistent. Bullpen is reliable.

sharp_consensus.prop_angle: SSG Top Hitter - Over Total Bases (Lotte bullpen struggling, high BB/9 leads to hard contact in scoring positions)
sharp_consensus.park: Sajik Baseball Stadium - Slightly hitter-friendly park in Busan
sharp_consensus.series_context: Opening game of series. SSG has strong form, Lotte struggling with pitching consistency.
sharp_consensus.clashOfStyles: SSG = balanced offense with good power. Lotte = inconsistent contact, shaky bullpen.
sharp_consensus.ssgAdvantage: SSG has clear pitching edge (4.30 ERA vs 4.90, 1.35 WHIP vs 1.42). Bullpen also stronger (3.90 vs 4.50 FIP).
sharp_consensus.lotteWeakness: Lotte's elevated BB/9 (3.5) combined with SSG's patient approach (.342 OBP) spells trouble. Free passes kill.
sharp_consensus.sharpReasoning: Sharp money sides with SSG on the road. Lotte's pitching staff in poor form, giving up too many walks. SSG's balanced attack should find success at Sajik.
